name: Amplifier Browser Bridge
description: Android-safe variant: identical to manifest.json but omits the debugger permission. chrome.debugger is genuinely absent on Edge Android (design doc §2/§7) -- declaring it here is unnecessary and, per the task's guidance to avoid installation risk on Android, deliberately left out. Every command still works via injection (chrome.scripting); only CDP-requiring commands (trusted input, capture_hidden screenshot) will fail loud with a clear 'capability unavailable on this device' error instead of silently degrading -- see hub.py's _ensure_cdp_attached and docs/POLICY.md.
